reference_memory.scope: Analytical sizing, not a measured full-reference peak and not a numerical allowance. No rig or HF execution.

control_evidence.peak_RSS_or_cgroup_memory_peak: Not recorded. Host MemAvailable samples include unrelated machine activity and cannot establish process peak. Successful 12 GiB cap provides an empirical admission ceiling for this prior 80-token workload only.

reference_memory.attention_derivation: One eager score tensor at last prefill chunk: 1 x 16 query heads x 512 queries x 16384 keys x 4 bytes = 512 MiB. Conservative three-score accounting covers matmul/scaling/mask/softmax lifetimes; actual simultaneous lifetime depends on pinned eager implementation and allocator. Repeated K/V after GQA expansion contributes 256 MiB for the active layer, not 28 times that. DynamicCache concatenation can transiently retain old and new active-layer K/V. F16 logical cache is rounded then widened, so HF storage is F32.
reference_memory.empirical_cross_check: Start from the prior successful 12 GiB control ceiling; add 3.592 GiB cache growth, about 1.9 GiB conservative attention/cache scratch growth and 0.25 GiB output-page growth. This suggests roughly 17.7 GiB before an extra safety margin, consistent with retaining 20 GiB. This is conservative sizing, not proof of the actual RSS or a claim every term peaks simultaneously.
reference_memory.loader_note: Config-only model allocates final independent head topology from the outset. Existing exhaustive loader copies each independently decoded tensor into its parameter one at a time. Model plus largest decoded tensor is 8.728 GiB before imports/decoder temporary arrays; the successful identical 80-token loader already ran under 12 GiB. No unused original checkpoint is loaded.
limitations: The pinned transformers 4.55.2 eager source/allocator peak was not instrumented in the completed run; temporary counts here are conservative shape-derived allowances, not a measurement.

The probe compile container has no Transformers dependency. Before an expensive reference, retain the actual reference process peak/cgroup memory.peak alongside per-phase progress; never treat system-memory deltas as process peak.

host_admission.decision: Below the unchanged 22 GiB admission guard. Do not launch full references or lower the 20 GiB cap to current availability.
